name: Jewel Bubbles 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Jewel Bubbles 3 is a free puzzle game. Hey ho, let's go. Get three in a row and watch the jewels blow. This jewel Bubbles a fast-paced three in a row style game where you must puzzle your way through a never-ending barrage of colorful jewel bubbles. In order to make the, go away you'll need to swipe and swap them one at a time to dash them. As they blow up they also change the landscape of the board and more and more jewel bubbles will pop up. Unlock cool powers and Omni-bombs which allow you to take out all the rows, columns, and blocks you want. Jewel bubbles is a minimal game with a few simple moves and an endless amount of replays. Find the patterns, slide the jewels, save the day.
